claims.statement: From 2026, qualifying importers must declare embedded emissions and surrender CBAM certificates, whose price tracks EU ETS auctions, creating cash, forecasting and evidence exposure.
Authorized CBAM declarants importing more than the stated 50-tonne threshold are the direct economic actors, but appetite for outsourced treasury operations is unknown.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: CFO, tax director or trade-compliance head
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Joint emissions-data and cash-exposure forecast; customs brokers and Big Four firms can bundle
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business under direct declarant mandates
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Customs brokers, freight forwarders and finance advisers

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Retainer prepaid monthly; certificate cash remains customer-owned
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 55-70% after analyst review and partner fees
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Data reconciliation, scenario modeling and filing support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Legal advice, insurance, secure controls and segregation of duties
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Monthly retainer plus volume tier; no speculative certificate trading
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Data feeds, customs partner and carbon-accounting review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Customs brokers, accountants and ERP vendors extend CBAM services
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Certificate purchase and annual surrender against verified embedded emissions; measurable loss is excess working capital, penalties or shipment friction
commercial_mechanics.payer: Authorized CBAM declarant or indirect customs representative
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Crossing the import threshold, annual declaration or volatile certificate exposure
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly import cycle and annual surrender

contrary_evidence: Customers may retain treasury internally due to liability.
Simplified thresholds reduce the smaller-importer market.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: No present mandate; proposed workflow-integration and advisory agreement without custody of customer funds
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell scenario software without operational mandate or partner with another customs broker
critical_control_point.current_owner: Declarants control imports, funds and filings; national authorities control certificate accounts
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business under direct declarant mandates
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No present importer mandate or registry access
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business only after customer authorization; certificate execution remains with declarant or regulated partner
critical_control_point.subject: CBAM exposure forecasting and certificate-surrender workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Sell fixed-fee exposure diagnostics, avoid fund custody, then integrate recurring forecasts with one customs partner
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 180 customers at 60,000 PLN annual revenue and 25% EBITDA yields 2.7m PLN EBITDA; 4-6x supports 5m+ founder equity in years 6-8. Liability, sales cycles and pricing are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly until analyst and trade specialist are hired
economics.gross_margin_basis: Retainers less carbon-accounting review, integrations and customer support
economics.payback: Assumption: 6-10 diagnostics repay build cost within 12 months
economics.pricing: Assumption: 8,000-25,000 PLN diagnostic and 3,000-12,000 PLN monthly retainer
economics.retention_or_repeat: Recurring imports, price changes and annual declarations

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Importer-specific emissions/cash forecast history and reconciliation rules
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Declarant pays around certificate purchases and annual surrender
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Variable carbon-certificate liability enters import working capital

founder_fit: B2B analytical delivery limits social exposure.

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: embedded import to surrender reconciliation workflow
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: authorized declarant retains registry and fund control

structure.critical_dependency: Declarant authorization and verified producer emissions

thesis: Future state: CBAM certificates are a recurring treasury exposure for importers. The missing financial-coordination mechanism is a non-custodial workflow forecasting liability, reconciling evidence and scheduling surrender.
title: CBAM Certificate-Treasury Desk
